requirement: Implement a Python module that contains a linked list class with insert, delete, search, and reverse methods. All methods must be covered by tests.

spec.name: Singly Linked List Module
spec.description: A Python module (linked_list.py) providing a singly linked list class `LinkedList` (with an internal `Node` class) that supports insert, delete, search, and reverse operations, plus a pytest test suite (test_linked_list.py) covering every method, including edge and error cases. Design decisions: values may be any Python object compared with ==; `insert(value, index=None)` appends to the tail when index is None, otherwise inserts before the given position (0 = head, len = tail); an out-of-range or non-integer index raises IndexError / TypeError respectively; `delete(value)` removes the first node whose value equals the argument and returns True, or returns False if not found (no exception); `search(value)` returns the zero-based index of the first match or -1 if absent; `reverse()` reverses the list in place and returns None. The class also supports len(), iteration, and `to_list()` to make behaviour testable.

acceptance_criteria.text: A new LinkedList() is empty: len() is 0, to_list() returns [], and iterating yields nothing.
insert(value) with no index appends the value at the tail; inserting 1, 2, 3 in order gives to_list() == [1, 2, 3] and len() == 3.

insert(value, index) inserts the value so it ends up at that position: index 0 inserts at the head, index == len(list) inserts at the tail, and a middle index inserts between existing nodes, preserving the order of other elements.
insert with an index that is negative or greater than len(list) raises IndexError and leaves the list unchanged; a non-integer index (e.g. 'a' or 1.5) raises TypeError.

delete(value) removes the first node equal to value and returns True; it works for head, middle, and tail nodes and for a single-element list, and len() decreases by 1; when duplicates exist only the first occurrence is removed.
delete(value) on an empty list or with a value not present returns False and leaves the list unchanged.
search(value) returns the zero-based index of the first node equal to value, or -1 if the value is not present (including on an empty list).

reverse() reverses the list in place so to_list() returns the elements in the opposite order, and returns None; it works for lists of length 0, 1, 2 and many; after reversing, insert (append), delete, and search operate correctly on the new order (tail is updated correctly).
The module provides __len__ and __iter__ (and to_list()) that always reflect the current state after any sequence of insert, delete and reverse operations.
A pytest test file exercises every public method (insert, delete, search, reverse, len, iteration, to_list) including the success, edge and error cases above, and all tests pass.

tasks.title: LinkedList skeleton with Node, len, iteration, to_list
tasks.description: Create linked_list.py with a Node class (value, next) and LinkedList class with head, size tracking, __len__, __iter__, and to_list(). Create test_linked_list.py with tests for the empty list.
acceptance_criteria: LinkedList() has len 0, to_list() == [], list(iter(ll)) == []
Node and LinkedList importable from linked_list
Tests for empty list pass with pytest

tasks.title: Implement insert (append and positional) with validation
tasks.description: Implement insert(value, index=None). No index appends to tail; index inserts at that position (0..len). Raise IndexError for negative or > len indexes without modifying the list; raise TypeError for non-int index (bool may be treated as invalid too). Add tests.
acceptance_criteria: Appending 1,2,3 yields [1,2,3] and len 3
insert at index 0, middle, and len produce correct order
Negative index and index > len raise IndexError and list unchanged
Non-integer index ('a', 1.5) raises TypeError
Inserting into an empty list at index 0 works
Tests for all of the above pass

tasks.title: Implement search
tasks.description: Implement search(value) returning the zero-based index of the first node equal to value, or -1. Add tests.
acceptance_criteria: Returns correct index for head, middle, tail values
Returns first index when duplicates exist
Returns -1 for missing value and for an empty list
Tests pass

tasks.title: Implement delete
tasks.description: Implement delete(value) removing the first matching node and returning True, or returning False if not found. Keep size consistent. Add tests.
acceptance_criteria: Deleting head, middle, tail, and the only element works and returns True
len decreases by 1 after successful delete
Only first duplicate removed
Missing value or empty list returns False and list unchanged
Tests pass

tasks.title: Implement reverse and integration tests
tasks.description: Implement in-place reverse() returning None. Add tests for lengths 0,1,2,many, double reverse restoring the original, and a mixed sequence test of insert/delete/search after reverse (verifying append goes to the correct tail). Confirm every public method is exercised by the test suite.
acceptance_criteria: Reverse works on lengths 0, 1, 2 and many and returns None
Reversing twice restores the original order
After reverse, append, delete and search behave correctly on the new order
len and iteration are correct after mixed operations
Full pytest run passes with all methods covered
